title: Image cache gets better at reading prompts
summary:
Image caching learned more languages, got more careful about prompt differences, and now says what kind of match it found.

Image semantic caching now uses multilingual embeddings and the original prompt text. Prompt-length-dependent thresholds make cache matching more flexible for short prompts while tests guard against treating small but meaningful differences as the same request. Responses also distinguish exact from semantic cache hits.

daily.title: Inspect image cache matches
daily.text: Image responses now use `X-Cache-Type` to distinguish exact from semantic cache hits. Semantic hits also report their similarity score.
